claims.text: Many reviewers report that the product is extremely messy, staining the sink and getting everywhere, though some say it is worth it.
Several reviewers say it did not whiten their teeth at all even after consistent use, and some suspect the positive reviews are fake.
A number of reviewers report noticeable whitening results, sometimes after the first use.
Some reviewers mention gum or mouth irritation and reactions from using the product.
A few reviewers note that consistency is required and that it can stain under nails or require extra rinsing.
